title: com.enroll arguments: take a Project's responder slot for a capability (fabric-project-comms/0.1, DEC-0073)
description: The responder is the authenticated session; a supplied process id, model name, origin, launcher label or descriptor never authorizes it. Estate, caller Project, principal and session come from the authenticated endpoint and are never accepted here: an unknown field is refused (invalid_arguments). Any participant reply of the request's target Project moves a queued request to answered, whatever the slot's state, so a participant without the responder grant replies to a queued request only when its capability's slot is absent at generation 0 (no service ever held it), once, that it cannot be taken now, why and what would lift it; with the slot active, stale, or absent at a later generation it sends no reply and does no work on the request, leaving it to that service, and asks the operator unless an active holder has it (enroll refused fenced). A session that enrolls answers each request it claims in the same turn by a com.progress note or a fenced reply carrying the state, and settles it with com.accept, then com.complete (DEC-0152 SA-2, SA-6).

capability.description: A capability of the caller's Project; the slot's Project comes from the endpoint, and the host's responder grant for it is checked in the same statement.
